Amazon has launched TorchNeuron in public beta: an open-source framework that lets developers run PyTorch code on Amazon's Trainium chips with no rewriting needed. The pitch is a direct attack on Nvidia's software moat - making the switch from CUDA to Amazon's own AI chips as simple as changing a backend.
